title: 桜花賞の後に・心躍る挑戦

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove gives a splendid performance at the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having faced off against powerful opponents, the thought of the even more difficult races ahead lights a fire of determination within Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to do even better at the Japanese Oaks, Air Groove keeps up the pace as she moves ever forward.
